articles.title: Warhammer Survivors is out now - review
articles.summary: Warhammer Survivors has arrived from Auroch Digital as a licensed version of Vampire Survivors wearing the skin of Warhammer. Note: this was a personal purchase.

articles.title: llm 0.37.2
articles.summary: Release: llm 0.37.2 Fixes a security issue reported by Daniel de Araujo in GHSA-v9h7-jj4g-f862 and GHSA-r639-rr7r-x72w . LLM has a mechanism called extra-openai-models.yaml - now managed by the new-in-0.37 llm openai endpoint add command - for using LLM with OpenAI-compatible API endpoints from other providers.

articles.title: PlayStation 2 Slim M.2 SATA SSD Mod

articles.title: iPhone Duo one week later: The future, or not for me?
articles.summary: If iPhone Duo is the future of the iPhone, I’ll adapt and move on with my life. But one week in, I think it’s probably just not for me.

articles.title: Google Wallet rolling out digital Google Home keys with supported locks on Android
articles.summary: Behind the scenes, the digital key is linked to the Google Home app rather than a single lock. As such, “each of your compatible Aliro locks will work with a single key in your Google Wallet.” Keys are added to Google Wallet using the Home app, which will prompt you to save after setup.

articles.title: Hand-drawn dino adventure Zid Journey gets a new trailer, set to arrive in Q2 2027
articles.summary: The dinosaurs are back! Zid Journey is the second game in the Zid and Zniw series: inspired by classic adventure games. It's set to arrive in Q2 2027.

articles.title: Google joins the decision-model wave with Gemini Decision 1, scoring 1,000 questions in a single pass
articles.summary: Google Deepmind is introducing the Gemini Decisions API, an interface built for fast, closed-ended decisions like yes/no questions, multiple choice, and scale-based ratings. The underlying model, Gemini Decision 1 , processes up to 1,000 independent questions in a single pass across text, images, audio, video, and PDFs.

articles.title: It’s Elite, For The Commodore Pet
articles.summary: It will be a surprise to Commodore Pet owners then, that over four decades later, [David Given] has ported the game to their platform .

articles.title: Zellij Release v0.46.0
articles.summary: This release includes a major addition in Zellij: Zellij is now also a desktop terminal. To run it: zellij terminal . It works on linux, mac and windows.

articles.summary: When I first saw Devolver Digital tease a "AAA" game, I knew it would be a stupid troll joke - but the game All Army Attack does sound interesting.

articles.title: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
articles.summary: Introducing the Gemini Decisions API, powered by our new Gemini Decision 1 model. Evaluate up to 1,000 yes/no, choice, and rubric-scoring questions in a fast, single pass across text, images, audio, video, and PDFs.

articles.title: iCloud+ has new perk in iOS 27 if you pay for more storage
articles.summary: The tentpole feature of iCloud+ is cloud storage, but Apple keeps improving and expanding the service to include other perks too. And in iOS 27, iCloud+ has a new benefit for high-storage tiers: AI features for HomeKit cameras.

articles.title: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare.
articles.summary: Google Cloud has announced Gemini for healthcare , an AI solution engineered to unify fragmented clinical, operational, and administrative systems. Moving beyond simple information retrieval, it enables healthcare teams to turn siloed data into coordinated action.

articles.title: Issue types and fields are available for personal accounts
articles.summary: Issue types and issue fields are now generally available on repositories owned by personal accounts. This brings the same planning capabilities to individual developers and open source maintainers to standardize your workflows and organize issues across repositories.

articles.title: FreeBSD Working To Establish An AI Policy After Polling Developers

articles.title: What if your Virtual Data Room (VDR) was Android™ based?
